tickets.title: Display sign up form
tickets.description: The system shall display the sign up form with the fields above and a "Sign up" button.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall display the sign up form with the fields above and a "Sign up" button.

acceptance_criteria.text: Full name must be 2 to 60 characters; letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Email must be valid email format; maximum 254 characters; unique, case-insensitive.
acceptance_criteria.quote: Valid email format; maximum 254 characters; unique, case-insensitive

acceptance_criteria.text: Password must be 8 to 64 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one symbol.

acceptance_criteria.text: Confirm password must match the password.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall keep the "Sign up" button disabled until all required fields are valid.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall let the user show or hide the password and confirm password values.
acceptance_criteria.quote: The system shall let the user show or hide the password and confirm password values.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall show a password strength indicator while the user types.
acceptance_criteria.quote: The system shall show a password strength indicator while the user types.

acceptance_criteria.text: The page shall include a "Already have an account? Log in" link to the login page.

tickets.title: Process account registration
tickets.description: On submit, the system shall check that the email is not already registered and reject the request with a clear message if it is.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall check that the email is not already registered and reject the request with a clear message if it is.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall store the password only as a salted hash and never return it in any response.

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall create the account in an unverified state and send a verification email containing a link valid for 24 hours.
